page.content:
Goliath barbarian of the Herd of Storms, Pike's best friend.

How Grog Strongjaw connects

  • Faction: Vox Machina — Grog Strongjaw is the barbarian of Vox Machina.
  • Character: Travis Willingham — Travis Willingham plays Grog Strongjaw.

What is Grog Strongjaw?

Grog Strongjaw is Travis Willingham's Campaign 1 barbarian, a goliath whose Craven Edge, Titanstone Knuckles, and loyalty to Pike define Vox Machina's muscle.

Key threads lead to Vox Machina and Travis Willingham.
